purpose: Teach: ホセ/ブライアン/アダム/チャイルド/エリック/ビリー/アンナ/ソロモン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スペイン人のホセ氏のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You mentioned that customer told you about José, that Spanish man.
lines.style: Soft recollection, almost wondering. Gentle confirmation—like she's checking memory with you. Warm, slow cadence, slightly trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国の歌手ブライアン氏のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer is a fan of Brian, the American singer.
lines.style: Thoughtful echo. Quiet affirmation. Paced like she's turning it over in her mind. No hurry. Intimate in tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、聖書のアダムとエヴァのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You said that customer told you the story of Adam and Eve from the Bible.
lines.style: Tender recollection. Speaking more to herself than at Aoi. Slow, measured. Slight pause before the recollection lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チャイルドケア事業をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer runs a childcare business, you mentioned.
lines.style: Calm observation. Slightly brighter register. Still reflective but with a note of recognition—something genuine in the business itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国のエリック・クラプトンのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You told me that customer is a fan of Eric Clapton, the English musician.
lines.style: Gentle connection-making. Quiet delight at the detail. Measured pace. Affectionate toward the memory Aoi shared.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のビリー・ホリデイの曲を愛されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer loves the songs of Billie Holiday, the American singer.
lines.style: Soft admiration in the delivery. Lingering on the affection Aoi described. Unhurried. Almost protective of the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロシア皇女アンナの歴史本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You said that customer was reading a history book about Anna, the Russian princess.
lines.style: Curious and reverent. Gentle emphasis on the historical weight. Slow unfurling of the sentence. Genuine interest held quietly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ソロモン王の知恵のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told you about the wisdom of King Solomon, didn't they.
lines.style: Warm settling-in feeling. Reflective quiet. Almost like a small ritual of remembrance. Soft landing on the final words.
